newsitem.title: USA: FBI chief en route to Saudi Arabia for bombing talks.
newsitem.headline: FBI chief en route to Saudi Arabia for bombing talks.

text.p: FBI Director Louis Freeh is en route to Saudi Arabia for talks on the investigation into the June 25 truck bombing that killed 19 U.S. servicemen, a federal law enforcement official said on Friday.

"This is a positive meeting, not a scolding," the official said. FBI officials previously had complained about a lack of cooperation from Saudi authorities in the investigation into the bombing at the U.S. military housing complex in Dhahran.
The official said Saudi authorities wanted to update Freeh on the progress of their investigation.
The visit marks the third time that Freeh has gone to Saudi Arabia since the bombing, the official said.
In a brief statement later issued by the FBI, the agency said the visit "comes in the context of U.S. support for Saudi efforts to solve this heinous crime."

Defense Secretary William Perry told reporters on Nov. 1 that the United States has not yet concluded who was responsible for the bombing. According to diplomatic sources at the time, Saudi authorities were holding about 40 Saudi citizens believed to have been implicated in the bombing.
